## Text styles (Typography)
| Class | Code | Size | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rp-page-title` / `rp-text-h4` | `variant="h4"` | 34/40 500 | Page title |
| `rp-text-h6` | `variant="h6"` (Figma Title) | 20/28 400 | Tile, dialog and drawer titles |
| `rp-text-subtitle1` | `variant="subtitle1"` | 16/24 500 | Empty state headline |
| `rp-text-subtitle2` | `variant="subtitle2"` | 14/22 600 | Small headings |
| `rp-text-body1` | `variant="body1"` | 16/24 | Primary text, person names, numbers |
| `rp-text-body2` (body default) | `variant="body2"` | 14/22 | Default text |
| `rp-text-caption` | `variant="caption"` | 12/18 | Secondary lines, labels, table headers |

Weights: `rp-text-semibold`, `rp-text-bold`. Colors: `rp-text-secondary` (#636363), `rp-text-active` (link blue #35678F), `rp-text-error`, `rp-text-success`, `rp-text-hint`, `rp-text-disabled`. Font: Noto Sans (400, 500, 600, 700), lining tabular numbers.

## Link
```html
<a class="rp-link" href="#">View all reviews</a>
```

## Icons
`<span class="rp-icon rp-icon-search"></span>` = `<Search size={24} />`. Names = the production icon file in kebab case (`AddGroup` → `rp-icon-add-group`). Sizes `rp-icon-size-12 | 16 | 20 | 32 | 48 | 80`, default 24. Look names up in `foundation/icons-full-reference.md`. Icons take the text color; default icon color is #636363.

## Writing (ReviewPro product copy)
- **Title Case**: page titles, tile titles, dialog and drawer titles, navigation items, tab labels, settings link titles.
- **Sentence case**: buttons, menu items, field labels, table headers, chips, helper and error text, snackbars, alerts, empty states, tooltips.
- Errors: one sentence, no period, say what to do ("Email is required"). Never "Something went wrong" or error codes.
- Use "email" (one word), "check-in" / "checkout", "establishment" (hotel or restaurant), "group".
